title: GPT + Gemini · compatibility mode · published metrics
notes: Native dual channel: JSON and XAIOP generated separately (no JSON→XAIOP translation).
Structure rate excludes networkSkip (empty completion bodies).
XAIOP fair prompt/total exclude Skill body; API totals may appear as *_api on XXL shards.
Payloads, previews, parse snippets, and local artifact paths are stripped.
